Thanks for the ping. Quick read of the network diagram: a few immediate notes before the call —
- Need explicit egress rules per subnet for telemetry endpoints; currently diagram shows broad 0.0.0.0/0 egress from the GPU subnet. Will require NAT GW in the DMZ or selective egress proxies.
- VLAN tagging looks fine, but we should confirm MTU settings on the switch infra for large pipelined gRPC payloads (1500 vs 9000).
- Confirm that the management plane (ansible control host) is on a separate management VLAN with jumpbox hardened and MFA enforced.

I'll prepare annotated diagram snippets for the meeting and flag the pieces that will impact the Helm values (service annotations, hostNetwork usage).

— Hiro
Principal Infrastructure Engineer

Quick pass from the Terraform/CI side. I've attached a tiny patch with recommended tfvars policy checks (tfvars-policy.patch). Highlights: 
- Enforce module input validation (type/allowed) and add a "placement_profile" variable instead of freeform "instance_type" to reduce drift.
- Add a terratest stage in the pipeline that runs against a local k3s cluster for Helm charts (sanity smoke tests).
- Secrets: move any KMS/HSM key ids to encrypted parameter store; remove plaintext in example tfvars.

CI gating: require changed‑module PRs to pass a terratest job + a static check that flags changes to public ingress rules. Recommend a branch protection rule that blocks merges without two infra approvers (one must be network lead).

Att: tfvars-policy.patch

— Marcus
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference
